capabilities: Number display equations only when at least one block link points to them
Render block links as formatted equation numbers in Reading view, Live Preview, embeds and PDF export
Create block IDs through Obsidian's link suggestions without typing them
Customize same-note and other-note reference formats with placeholders
Restyle numbers via CSS variables and classes
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; beta versions are installed via BRAT; the README documents limitations (no numbering inside callouts, quotes or lists, no per-line align numbering, no chapter prefixes, Canvas links not counted).
intentEvidence: Equation Refs instead uses Obsidian's native block links, numbers only the equations you link to, and never edits your notes.
problem: Obsidian numbers all display equations or none, and other equation-numbering plugins use LaTeX \label/\ref syntax or write numbers into note files.
